newsitem.title: USA: US corp debt players await J.C. Penney deal debut.
newsitem.headline: US corp debt players await J.C. Penney deal debut.

text.p: J.C. Penney Co's $2.0 billion five-part debt offering is expected to take center stage as players focus on the performance of the deal as the underwriter gets set to wrap up the last scene, players said.

Issuers faced with higher borrowing costs, contemplating whether or not to move forward with financing, amid a rising rate environment, are expecting J.C. Penney's deal will set the tone in the market.
"This deal will set the tone," said one syndicate source. "Issuers will be watching to see if it's met with good reception and if sidelined buyers budge."

But already in its pre-pricing stage the five-part deal is said to be issue-bid, meeting with good investor demand in every tranche, leading some to believe that the deal will have to be upped in size, dealers said.
"The deal is going pretty well right now...all tranches are issue-bid," said another syndicate source. "If the deal continues to gain momentum I'm sure it will grow in size."
Price talk on the $600 million five year issue is seen between +45-50 basis points over U.S. Treasuries.
Price talk on the $400 million 10-year issue is seen at +70 basis points over Treasuries.
